mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate indicates monetary easing, which may lead to increased borrowing and investment, thereby driving up S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases but S&P 500 returns are negative over the next 20 days more than 50% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate suggests economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE increases but S&P 500 returns are positive over the next 5 days more than 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment increases but the unemployment rate does not decrease, it may indicate labor market inefficiency, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases without a corresponding decrease in UNRATE but S&P 500 returns are positive over the next 60 days more than 50% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production suggests stronger economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases but S&P 500 returns are negative over the next 20 days more than 50% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts indicates stronger demand in the housing market, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases by >50 units in 1 month
failure_condition: If HOUST increases but S&P 500 returns are negative over the next 5 days more than 50% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is below 1%, it indicates an accommodative monetary policy, which may boost equity markets, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS remains below 1% but S&P 500 returns are negative over the next 60 days more than 50% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real GDP indicates a strong economy, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 increases but S&P 500 returns are negative over the next 60 days more than 50% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP growth outpaces CPI inflation, it indicates a healthy economy, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 growth outpaces CPIAUCSL but S&P 500 returns are negative over the next 20 days more than 50% of the time.
